name: Tsumishiro no Wa ~Yakata ni Himerareshi Shinjitsu~
original_name: 罪しろの環～館に秘められし真実～
source:
Main character has been separated from his mother in the childhood. Now he gets a telegram about his mother funeral. He reunites with his sister and the maid of the mansion. However, cursed memories of the past linger in this place. One day sister brings him a collar asking to put it on her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角从小就与母亲分离。现在他收到一封关于他母亲葬礼的电报。他与妹妹和宅邸女仆重逢。然而，过去被诅咒的记忆却在这个地方挥之不去。有一天，姐姐给他带来了一个项圈，要求给她戴上……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
